race.title: StoneX Payments Juvenile Hurdle (GBB Race)
race.verdict: SILVER STATE 's stamina needs to be taken on trust but there's no doubting he's the clear pick on Flat form (useful 4-time winner) and he could well be worth siding with having joined a yard that do particularly well with such types in this discipline. Pass The Buck and Lion In Zion may emerge best of those with prior hurdles experience, whilst James Choice is another interesting recruit from the Flat. SILVER STATE (IRE) PASS THE BUCK (IRE) LION IN ZION (FR)
race.bettingForecast: Pass The Buck (7/4), Silver State (2/1), Lion In Zion (11/2), Cape View (7/1), James Choice (7/1), Houndswood Willow (10/1), Plan C (14/1), Don Pablo Colina (50/1), Rebel Legend (66/1), Pete's Sake (100/1), Dundeelin (150/1)
